parameter: Expansion adults off Medicaid from work rules by Dec 2027
basis: Arkansas 2018: 18% of those subject lost coverage in 7 months; CBO long run about 26% of expansion adults

parameter: Share of 12-month Medicaid losses reached by June 2027
basis: CMS lets states start six-month renewals at each person's next renewal

parameter: Extra procedural losses from six-month renewals
basis: Unwinding-era procedural disenrollment rates scaled to one extra renewal

parameter: Immigrants losing Medicaid/CHIP and Medicare (each)
basis: CBO: about 100000 more uninsured from each restriction

parameter: People off SNAP because of the law in 2027
basis: CBO 2.4M average month; observed caseload drop 4.3-4.5M since Jan 2025 only partly due to the law

parameter: People losing Marketplace coverage or subsidy by Dec 2027
basis: HHS: up to 2M fewer enrollees from verification; CBO: about 900000 uninsured from immigrant rule

parameter: Medicaid work-rule losers also off SNAP (removed as duplicates)
basis: Same adults face both work rules

parameter: Job losers already counted in another group
basis: Assumption

parameter: Unemployment rate Q4 2027
basis: Federal Reserve September 2026 projections (median 4.1; range 4.0-4.5); Sept 2026 actual 4.2%

parameter: Jobs lost per $1 billion of lost federal spending
basis: Commonwealth Fund/GWU IMPLAN: 1.22M jobs per $131B

parameter: Federal Medicaid spending per expansion adult
basis: 90% federal share of typical expansion adult cost

parameter: Average SNAP benefit
basis: USDA FY2025-26 averages

parameter: Average premium tax credit lost
basis: Marketplace subsidy after enhanced credits expired

parameter: GDP lost per $1 of Medicaid spending cut
basis: Commonwealth Fund/GWU: $154B GDP per $131B cut (1.18)

parameter: GDP lost per $1 of SNAP benefits cut
basis: USDA ERS and Moody's estimates for SNAP in a weak-to-normal economy

parameter: GDP lost per $1 of premium tax credit cut
basis: Assumption

parameter: State and local taxes lost per $1 of GDP lost
basis: Commonwealth Fund/GWU: $12.2B per $154.3B (7.9%)

parameter: Coverage losers who stay uninsured
basis: Arkansas 2018: no rise in other coverage among those who lost Medicaid

parameter: ER visits per newly uninsured person
basis: Medicaid adults about 0.99 a year (T-MSIS 2022 acute care data); uninsured adults use the ER less (CDC NHIS)

parameter: Hospital cost per ER visit
basis: HCUP 2021: $610 for uninsured/self-pay treat-and-release visits, inflated to 2027

parameter: Hospital stays per newly uninsured person
basis: HCUP 2012: about 2.0M uninsured stays for about 47M uninsured people

parameter: Hospital cost per inpatient stay
basis: HCUP 2012: $8,800 per uninsured stay, inflated to 2027

parameter: Share of that hospital cost never paid
basis: Self-pay patients pay a small fraction of hospital bills; the rest is uncompensated care

parameter: New out-of-pocket costs per newly uninsured person
basis: Assumption from MEPS spending of uninsured adults

parameter: Part B premium increase
basis: 2026 Trustees projection $202.90 to $209.50; 54-58M people pay it themselves

parameter: Part D changes
basis: $85 higher deductible for 10-18M people; $300 higher cap for 1.3-2.4M; stand-alone premiums +$3-10 a month for 17-21M
